title: Property Inspector
description: Displays the settings, tags, transforms, and components of your active selection. Use the Property Inspector to configure scenes, layers, entities, and prefab overrides.

blocks.content: The **Property Inspector** sits on the right side of the editor and adapts automatically to what you select in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) or [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport). Every change you make updates the canvas in real time.

items.title: Context-Aware
items.desc: Switches between scene settings, layer settings, and entity components automatically.

items.title: Modular Components
items.desc: Attach renderers, physics, colliders, audio, and scripts via **Add Component...**.

items.title: Multi-Tag System
items.desc: Assign multiple tags to an entity and rename tags across all scenes at once.

items.title: Prefab Syncing
items.desc: Track **Sync** and **Override** badges on [prefab](components/entities_and_prefabs) instances and update the master prefab.

blocks.content: The **Property Inspector** switches between four views depending on your active selection.

rows: Shows **Quick Actions** (toggles for **Show UI Bound**, **Show World Bounds**, and collider wireframe bounds) and **Scene Properties** (**Background Color**).
Shows the **Layer** section with **ID**, **Z-Index**, **Appearance** (active, visibility, lock), and **Opacity**.
Shows **Object**, [Transform & UI Transform](components/transform), all attached component sections, and **Add Component...** under **Actions**.

blocks.content: When you select an entity, its core identity and spatial sections appear at the top, followed by any attached components.

rows: Configures the unique entity **ID**, linked **Prefab** badge, multi-tag **Tag** selector, **Z-Index**, and **Appearance** (**Active**, visibility eye icon, and lock icon).
Controls **Position**, **Rotation**, **Pivot**, **Size (px)**, **Scale**, **Flip**, and (for user interface elements) the 3x3 **Anchor** grid.
Appears on [prefab](components/entities_and_prefabs) instances. **Sync** (green) means the section matches the master prefab; **Override** (amber) means a property was modified in the scene.
Click the 3-dots icon on any section header to **Reset Values**, **Remove Component**, **Sync Component**, or **Apply to Master**.

Dropdown under **Actions** that attaches [Visual Renderers](components/renderers), [Sprite Animator](components/sprite_animator), [Physics Body](components/physics_body), [Multi-Collider](components/multi_collider), [Audio Source](components/audio_source), or [Script Controller](components/script_controller).

blocks.message: An entity can have only one visual renderer at a time (**Image Renderer**, **Shape Renderer**, **Text Renderer**, or **Tilemap**). Once one is attached, the other three show **(Conflict)** in **Add Component...**.

blocks.content: Add components at the bottom of the inspector to give an entity visuals, physics, audio, or scripts.

items: Select an entity in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) or [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).
Scroll to the bottom of the **Property Inspector** and click **Add Component...** under **Actions**.
Choose a component such as **Physics Body** or **Collider**. The component section appears in the inspector.
To remove a component, click the 3-dots icon on that component's header and click **Remove Component**.

blocks.content: Assign one or more tags in the **Object** section so your visual scripts can identify or group entities.

items: Select an entity and locate the **Object** section at the top of the **Property Inspector**.
Click the **Tag** dropdown (**Select tag...**) and choose **Create New Tag...**.
Enter a tag name (such as **Player** or **Enemy**) and confirm. The tag appears in the assigned list above the dropdown.
Hover over an assigned tag and click the trash icon to remove it from the entity.

blocks.content: When you edit a property on a [prefab](components/entities_and_prefabs) instance (other than its X and Y position), the section badge changes from **Sync** to **Override**.

items: Select the modified prefab instance in the scene.
In the **Object** section header, click the 3-dots icon.
Click **Apply to Master** to push your local changes to the master prefab and update all synced instances.
Alternatively, click **Revert to Sync** to restore the master prefab values while keeping the entity's current position.

blocks.message: You cannot add or remove components on a linked prefab instance in the scene. Edit the master prefab from the **Prefabs** dock, or open the **Object** 3-dots menu and click **Unpack Prefab** first.
